description.value: Tim Hortons is Canada's iconic coffee-and-quick-service chain, and this Fort St. John location on 112th Street is one of two in the city. The menu spans brewed coffee, espresso drinks, baked goods, breakfast wraps, soups, and chili — a reasonable stop for a hot meal on a long northern BC ride. The location includes a drive-through and, per the website, dine-in seating.

address.value: 9704 112 Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 7C7
